Fix `plugins/home-react/src/extensions.test.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. yarn tsc (repo root) fails with:
plugins/home-react/src/extensions.test.tsx:68:50 - error TS2322: Type 'LazyExoticComponent<() => Element>' is not assignable to type 'LazyExoticComponent<() => Element> & ((props?: any) => Element)'.
  Type 'LazyExoticComponent<() => Element>' is not assignable to type '(props?: any) => Element'.
    Type 'ReactNode' is not assignable to type 'Element'.
      Type 'undefined' is not assignable to type 'ReactElement<any, any>'.

68       root.render(<CardExtension title="My card" Content={Content} />);
                                                    ~~~~~~~

  plugins/home-react/src/extensions.test.tsx:68:50
    68       root.render(<CardExtension title="My card" Content={Content} />);
                                                        ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
    The expected type comes from property 'Content' which is declared here on type 'IntrinsicAttributes & ComponentRenderer & { title?: string | undefined; } & { title: string; Content: LazyExoticComponent<() => Element>; } & ComponentParts & { ...; }'
The test passes a React.lazy component as Content, but ComponentParts.Content is typed as (props?: any) => JSX.Element. Fix the test so it type-checks (for example, render the lazy component inside a plain function component, or type the fixture to match ComponentParts) without changing extensions.tsx; the test must still prove CardExtension renders without app context and shows a progress indicator while lazy content loads.

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.

## Answer
